headings.strategy: Bold, tech-focused, tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter). Avoid Inter.

body.strategy: Clean, highly legible geometric sans for product details.

colors.rules: Avoid pure black. Use deep indigo/blue-black (#070b15). Neon cyan and purple should be used strictly for highlights, active states, and the running animations.

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam_animation: MANDATORY: Implement the 'running highlight animation' on the active Category tile in the sidebar, and on Product Cards during hover. Create this using a spinning conic-gradient wrapper with an inner dark card to mask the center, exposing only a 1px or 2px animated border.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-[#070b15]/70 for sticky headers and sidebar to maintain depth. CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header or surfaces with content under it.
visual_enhancers.hover_scaling: MANDATORY: Product cards must scale up slightly (hover:scale-[1.02]) on hover to fulfill the 'eska size thora bda kro' requirement.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use subtle colored box-shadows (e.g., shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0.3)]) when a card is active or hovered.

layouts.page_structure: Sidebar + Main Content area. Mobile: Sidebar becomes horizontal scrollable chips or bottom sheet. Desktop: Sidebar spans 3 cols (w-64), main content spans remaining space.
layouts.bento_grid: Use high density grids (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6) for products.
layouts.spacing: Generous padding inside hero banners (p-8 to p-12). Compact data-dense padding for product specs.

motion.running_border: CSS keyframe spinning a conic gradient layer behind a solid dark background inset.
motion.micro_interactions: Smooth transitions for scale, shadow, and border color (transition-all duration-300 ease-out).

components.sidebar_navigation: Vertical list of categories. The *active* category must feature the neon running border animation.
components.hero_banner: Large dark neon banner at the top of the category view. Overlay image with bg-gradient-to-r from-[#070b15] via-[#070b15]/80 to-transparent. Bold H1.
components.product_card: Dark surface. On hover: running neon border appears, scales up, and product image slightly zooms.
components.category_tiles: Large 2x4 grid as requested in the screenshot reference, acting as navigation hubs.

mobile_phones.description: Glowing smartphone screen, use for Mobile category or hero
Person holding glowing phone in dark, use for product highlight

smartwatches.description: Smartwatch dark textured band, use for wearables category
Space gray smartwatch, use for product

audio_gaming.description: Black wireless headphones on dark surface
Gaming headphones, use for Audio/Gaming category tile

accessibility.focus_states: Visible neon cyan focus rings for keyboard navigation.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over neon elements remains readable. Use dark text on cyan backgrounds if needed.
accessibility.motion_preference: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the spinning border.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Implement the 'running highlight animation' requested by the user. Use a custom CSS class in index.css (e.g., using @keyframes with a conic-gradient and mask, or border-image) to create an animated neon border. Apply this to the active category in the sidebar and to product cards on hover.
CRITICAL: Enlarge the product size slightly on interaction. Add 'transform hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform duration-300' to the product cards.
CRITICAL: Build the UI to mirror the provided screenshot layout: Sidebar on the left for categories, Hero banner on top of the main area, and large tiles for subcategories/products.

Ensure 'jab catgory pe click kre' functionality: clicking a sidebar category must dynamically update the main content area (hero, products) and show the sidebar item as 'active' (with the neon highlight).
Use the images provided in the guidelines for categories and dummy products. DO NOT use placeholder services.
Implement the dark/neon aesthetic heavily: deep backgrounds (#070b15) with cyan (#00e5ff) and purple (#8b5cf6) glows.
Do not use .tsx extensions, provide the JS guidelines and components in .js/.jsx format as per the existing codebase.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or flat grays for this theme.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy (e.g., glowing effects behind cards).
Do NOT apply 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions to avoid breaking transform animations.
Do NOT center align the app container. Text should flow naturally (left-aligned).
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
